review_method: Manual semantic review of stage policies, representative generated steps, composite boundaries, mandatory handoffs, router precedence, permission preservation, authorization stops, invalidation, fixtures, and mutations. Generated candidate metadata remains subject to deterministic exact-recompute gates.

boundary_samples.finding: A single root-cause outcome routes to root-cause-investigation; it does not activate the entire verification stage.

boundary_samples.boundary: stage Recipe versus bounded composite Recipe
boundary_samples.finding: Multiple independent verification outcomes use stage-08; cross-stage requirements-to-readiness work uses feature-build-and-verify.
Full lifecycle is explicit-only and ordered after all smaller targets; ambiguous requests fall back to governed intake.

boundary_samples.boundary: specialized UI Recipe versus general feature Recipe
boundary_samples.finding: Complete UI design and rendered review routes to the existing Phase 4 specialized Recipe without copying its step graph.

boundary_samples.boundary: mandatory lifecycle stage versus conditional atomic step
boundary_samples.finding: The fourteen spine stages retain handoffs, while every atomic step defaults to skipped unless its own outcome and prerequisites match.

boundary_samples.boundary: tool runtime support versus lifecycle approval
boundary_samples.finding: Stage 15 is conditional, returns to the blocked owner, and cannot approve requirements, implementation, release, or recovery.
Hard dependencies are prerequisites; optional edges do not force activation; feedback edges feed a future pass rather than block the current run.
Independent review remains non-mutating; source repair requires a separate writer identity and human-approved remediation scope.
Local readiness cannot push, modify a PR, comment, merge, deploy, or configure a provider.
Push, PR change, comment, merge, deployment, and provider configuration each stop for a fresh exact authorization; no approval cascades.
Observation is read-only and may recommend rollback; rollback remains disabled until separate current authorization.
Coordination may assemble roles and evidence but cannot acknowledge, silence, assign, comment, mitigate, or close provider incidents under external-read authority.
Learning can produce bounded artifacts; persistent local-system storage requires the separate local-learning-persistence identity and authorization.
Missing consent, minimization, redaction, retention, transfer, or deletion boundaries stops before external-Judge routing.
Every spine handoff carries all four artifact classes and all four invalidation causes; an upstream rerun invalidates dependent evidence.
Recipes, router, cases, and evaluation plan all remain evaluating and not-run-phase-9; no remote, browser-auth, provider, local-system, or production action was executed.

findings.finding: Initial router composite array placed full-software-lifecycle before bounded composites, allowing unsafe first-match implementations to choose the largest route.
findings.resolution: Compiler now orders bounded composites first and full-software-lifecycle last; Gate locks the order.

findings.finding: Initial protected-step rule omitted authorized-local-git even though local branch integration is a bounded local Git mutation.
findings.resolution: authorized-local-git now remains disabled pending current authorization alongside remote, local-system, and external-session actions.

findings.finding: Nested one-line JSON schema construction was syntactically fragile and failed py_compile.
findings.resolution: Schema construction was rewritten into named, shallow dictionaries and compiled successfully.
